title: Andy Taylor, guitarist of new wave icons Duran Duran, dead at 65
description: Andy Taylor, the original guitarist of the 1980s English new wave band Duran Duran, has died. He was 65.
text:
Andy Taylor, the original guitarist of the 1980s English new wave band Duran Duran, has died. Taylor's death was confirmed by his family and bandmates in a statement posted on social media and Duran Duran's website. "From the moment he arrived in Birmingham from the North East with a guitar.

And an unshakeable belief in what we could become, he brought an indelible fire and swagger to our music," the band said. "His playing drove the songs that took us around the world, and with a dry wit that was matched only by his wonderfully unsentimental, no-nonsense outlook on life he kept us grounded.
